integrity: First publication date refers to the 2025 initiating study; the later cited articles are related literature. Euler--Maclaurin and Laurent expansions give the infinite-limit proof; finite code checks are supporting diagnostics only.
scientific_limitations: Exact optimized energy of finite contiguous intervals in an infinite Ising chain; no assertion of a full finite-volume stochastic nucleation barrier, escape-time prefactor, diffuse field-theory saddle, or unbounded crossover-parameter uniformity.
title: Uniform marginal crossover for a one-dimensional power-law Ising droplet barrier
